sections.heading: C — General Information
sections.markdown:
## C — General Information

FACT_ID: sec02-F01 | anchor: A01
Registration with the county clerk precedes any highway driving, and buyers or newcomers must file within 15 days [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec02-F02 | anchor: A01
Renewals beat the expiry date with no grace period, a mailed notice goes out 45 days ahead, and missing it excuses nothing [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec02-F03 | anchor: A01
Operating uninsured is a criminal offense costing registration plus fines of $500 to $1,000 with up to 90 days in jail [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec02-F04 | anchor: A01
Minimum coverage means $25,000 per injured person and $50,000 per crash plus $25,000 for property, or a single $60,000 limit [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec02-F05 | anchor: A01
Policies must carry basic reparations benefits except on motorcycles, and proof of coverage rides in the vehicle on paper or a screen [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec02-F06 | anchor: A01
Students roll on home-state registration and insurance beside a Kentucky school ID, out-of-state scholars check local rules, and troops may title on out-of-state insurance [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec02-F07 | anchor: A02
Troops misfiled as standard policies should clear uninsured flags with service proof at the county clerk [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec02-F08 | anchor: A02
The State Police accommodate disabled testers and lean on a Medical Review Board of eye, nerve, mind, and rehab specialists advising licensing officials [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec02-F09 | anchor: A02
Seizure, blackout, or altered-awareness sufferers need 90 clear days to drive, reported by affidavit [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec02-F10 | anchor: A02
Legal vision means 20/60 in one eye with 35 degrees of side field each way and 25 degrees up and down [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec02-F11 | anchor: A02
The bioptic program takes 20/200 better-eye drivers reaching 20/60 through the device with a 120-by-80 field and stable eyes, trained by Vocational Rehabilitation [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec02-F12 | anchor: A03
Drivers reach the board through self-reported episodes, officials from physicians to judges, telling records, or two-citizen affidavits, then complete physician forms for a mailed decision [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec02-F13 | anchor: A03
Cars feed ground ozone that sickens lungs most in the young, old, and outdoor workers, so maintenance, smooth moderate driving, and fewer trips cut pollution [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec02-F14 | anchor: A03
Licensed Kentuckians may register as organ donors at issuance or renewal [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0029]
